words.gloss_range: compound interrogative-plus-connector; locally a consequence-linked rhetorical denial, not a neutral question
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:ʾa-fa}}) makes the ayah open as a challenge rather than as fresh information. The fa- ties the question back to the promised gardens of 68:34, while the interrogative force makes the proposed equation something the listener is meant to reject. The same opening also helps the discourse turn from a statement about the Lord into direct divine speech, so the classification question is posed by the one who would enact or refuse it. The opening belongs to a Quranic challenge style seen in other rhetorical compounds (10:35; 37:155; 45:21), and the later challenge about alleged partners (68:41) belongs to the same argumentative field, but here the particle's local job is to turn the prior promise into a consequence-driven refutation.

topics.headline: backward-linked denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening question rejects a consequence drawn from 68:34 rather than merely asking for information.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify a compound interrogative-connective opening with rhetorical negative force, so the CRITICAL rows on denial plus consequence survive directly.

topics.headline: speech-role shift into challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse move from promise language into direct divine interrogation, giving the rejected equation speaker-authority.
topics.reason: The particle launches the interrogative turn, and the following first-person verb supplies the speaker shift that the row observes.

topics.headline: continued challenge logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this opening belongs to a recurring challenge style, while the local force remains the denial of equal treatment in this clause.
topics.reason: The cited parallels and the later local challenge (68:41) support formulaic argumentative continuity, but they do not replace the local syntax of 68:35.

words.gloss_range: make, render, or treat as; locally narrowed to divine rendering/classifying with an object plus comparison complement
words.root_gloss_range: broad making range including creating, rendering into a state, naming, beginning an action, wages, and unrelated nominal branches; the local frame selects rendering or treating-as, not all branches
words.prose: {{ar:نَجْعَلُ}} ({{tr:najʿalu}}) is the governing verb that turns the ayah into a question about divine classification. Its root can range broadly over making and producing, but the local object plus comparison complement narrows the sense to rendering or treating the submitters as like the criminals. The active first-person imperfect keeps the speaker's agency present in the moment of the rhetorical test, so the clause does not ask whether an equivalence merely exists; it asks whether We would make such a likeness. The wording also joins a wider moral-equation formula, especially the denied making pattern in 45:21, while the same surah later reuses the making root in a selection context (68:50).

topics.headline: making as treating-as
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broad making verb is locally about rendering one moral class like another, not about simple creation.
topics.reason: The explicit object and comparison complement select the rendering/state branch of the root and rule out unrelated branches or a simple creation-only reading.

topics.headline: active divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proposed equivalence is tested against explicit divine agency, not left as a passive or impersonal classification.
topics.reason: The first-person plural imperfect and active voice are local morphology, and attachment evidence identifies the subject as the discourse speaker role.

topics.headline: one predicate organizes the contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one compact verb governs the whole architecture: speaker, object, and comparison source all gather around the classification act.
topics.reason: The attachment bundle marks the ayah as one verbal clause centered on this verb, so structural rows about hinge position and clause compression survive.

topics.headline: moral-equation formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local denied equation resonates with another moral-equation challenge (45:21) and with later same-surah making language (68:50), without those echoes controlling the local parse.
topics.reason: The references supply a formula and same-surah thread, while the local attachment frame remains the controlling evidence for sense.

words.gloss_range: the submitters; locally a definite active-participle class and first object, with wholeness/safety pressure narrowed through submission
words.root_gloss_range: broad field of soundness, safety, peace, submission, yielding, handover, and other nominal branches; the local participle selects the submitter class while retaining wholeness pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muslimīna}}) is the first object of the verb, so the submitters are the class being tested for a refused likeness. Its active-participle form keeps agency in view: they are not an abstract quality but people characterized by submission. The root field of {{ar:س ل م}} ({{tr:s-l-m}}) includes soundness, safety, peace, yielding, and handing over, but the local form narrows that range to submitters while allowing the wholeness pressure to remain. That is why the contrast with the severing criminal class matters: the two nouns share an al-mu-īn plural sound frame, yet the roots make wholeness and rupture face each other. The choice of submitters rather than a faith-label also keeps the distinction close to the Quranic contrast between saying one has submitted and claiming faith (49:14), and the same root returns in the surah as soundness (68:43).

topics.headline: positive class as first object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the submitters are the positive object under test, not a loose descriptive label.
topics.reason: The attachment bundle makes the word the explicit accusative object, and QAC identifies it as a definite masculine plural active participle.

topics.headline: submission with wholeness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the class name carries submission and wholeness together, while the local participle prevents the whole root range from being treated as the selected sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports soundness, safety, peace, submission, and handing-over branches, but the local active participle and object role select the submitter class.

topics.headline: formal echo with semantic opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two class nouns are made formally comparable while their roots push in opposite directions.
topics.reason: The paired plural forms and the two root fields support the CRITICAL claim that the ayah stages audible likeness while denying semantic equivalence.

topics.headline: specific submitter label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah uses a submission label, with Quranic contrast at 49:14 and a same-surah soundness return at 68:43, without turning this word into a full theology of every root branch.
topics.reason: The cited references give useful lexical pressure and same-surah continuity, but the local participle and object role keep the topic anchored to this class noun.

words.gloss_range: comparison preposition; locally the grammatical hinge that proposes likeness so the rhetorical question can reject it
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka-}}) is the one-letter hinge of the rejected equation. It governs the following class noun as a genitive comparison complement, so the clause does not place the two classes as identical bare objects; it proposes likeness and lets the rhetorical question cancel even that lesser similarity. Because the particle is bound to the following noun in recitation, the comparison source arrives as one compact unit. The nearby challenge about alleged partners (68:41) can illuminate the broader opposition group, but the particle's local payoff is more precise: it is where moral mismeasurement becomes grammatical.

topics.headline: genitive comparison hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second class enters through a comparison preposition, not as a bare second object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify the particle as a comparison preposition governing the following genitive complement.

topics.headline: likeness proposed and denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah briefly stages likeness in grammar so the rhetorical force can reject the likeness itself.
topics.reason: The particle's normal comparison value remains intact, while the surrounding rhetorical question makes that comparison the denied proposition.

topics.headline: one compact comparison phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one-letter particle fuses with its complement, making the proposed likeness compact and immediate.
topics.reason: The surface sequence and attachment relation support the claim that the comparison particle and its complement function as one tight unit.

topics.headline: later opposition-group link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminal comparison class is part of the surrounding opposition logic that later includes alleged partners (68:41), though the particle itself only marks likeness here.
topics.reason: The local particle does not name the later group, so the inter-ayah row is kept as a narrowed discourse link rather than a local syntactic claim.

words.gloss_range: the criminals/offenders; locally the definite active-participle comparison source governed by the likeness particle
words.root_gloss_range: broad field including cutting off, earning or causing to incur, guilt/offense, certainty formula, bodily bulk, color, heat, and names; the local participle selects offender/criminal agency, with severance and earned guilt as live pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the submitter class named earlier as the direct object of the rejected comparison

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimīna}}) lands as the final word and the comparison source the question refuses. Grammatically it is not the direct object like {{ar:ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muslimīna}}); it is the genitive complement governed by the comparison particle, which keeps the attempted likeness mediated even before it is denied. As an active participle, the word still names agents of offense, not merely the abstraction of crime. The root field of {{ar:ج ر م}} ({{tr:j-r-m}}) supports guilt, offense, earning culpability, and cutting or severance; locally those branches sharpen the criminal class as the severing counterpart to the submitter-wholeness class. After the promised gardens of 68:34, the cutting/harvest image can be heard as boundary pressure, but the selected sense remains criminal agency. The term also carries a recurring judgment-scene class profile (55:43; 74:41; 83:29), and its final matching al-mu-īn cadence makes the two nouns formally comparable while the root opposition and closure deny equivalence.

topics.headline: criminal class as comparison source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminal class completes the comparison as a governed source while retaining active offender agency.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word the complement of the comparison particle, and QAC identifies the local form as a definite active participle.

topics.headline: offense with severance pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminal label carries guilt and severance pressure, especially after 68:34's garden promise, while the local form still selects the offender class.
topics.reason: V4 supports cutting, earning, and guilt/offense branches, but the local active participle and comparison role narrow the branch pressure to criminal/offender agency.

topics.headline: recurring judgment counterpart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun imports a familiar judgment-scene counterpart class, with cited recurrences at 55:43, 74:41, and 83:29.
topics.reason: The contextual profile and cited references support a recurring criminal-class role without changing the local grammar.

topics.headline: parallel sound, opposed ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on the class made formally parallel to the submitters but semantically opposite to them.
topics.reason: The local order, final position, shared plural cadence, and opposed root images jointly support the closure topic.

topics.headline: body-mass branch blocked
topics.blocking_evidence: V4 separates bodily bulk as another root branch, while the local word is a definite active-participle offender class governed by the comparison particle; the body or mass branch is not the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The shared root is real, but the proposed body-as-site or material-weight payoff is not licensed by the local form, syntax, or selected lexical branch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative comparison أفنجعل ... كـ joins a state-producing نجعل to المسلمين and المجرمين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse tests an act of placing or turning two opposed predicates into one status: soundness and freedom from defect on one side, guilt and offense on the other.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state makes نجعل the operation that would impose equivalence.
Soundness and freedom from injury supply the positive state carried by المسلمين.
Guilt and offense supply the opposed state carried by المجرمين.

changed_reading.before: Will the two named groups receive different outcomes?
changed_reading.after: Can the divine act of status-making coherently collapse soundness and culpability into the same evaluative condition?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: المسلمين and المجرمين can be heard as opposed directions of agency within the same comparative frame.
baseline_models.mechanism: One predicate carries handing over and letting go; the other carries earning or causing an incurred consequence. The rejected likeness flattens release toward another into acquisition that returns as liability.

activation_trace.role: State-making supplies the proposed conversion of unlike agencies into one standing.
Handing over and letting go make surrender a relational release rather than merely a label.
Earning and causing to incur make criminality an acquired consequence-bearing action.

changed_reading.before: Muslims and criminals are two fixed identities.
changed_reading.after: The nouns condense contrary relational motions: yielding what one holds versus acquiring what one must answer for.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root fields of المسلمين and المجرمين permit a material contrast between sound integrity and severance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Soundness holds a thing intact, while cutting or harvesting removes a part from its living continuity. نجعل asks whether an imposed order could treat integrity and severing as materially alike.

activation_trace.role: Making something into being supplies the ordering act under interrogation.
Soundness supplies intactness as one pole of the comparison.
Cutting and harvesting supply severance as the other pole.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts morally good and bad collectives.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether preserving wholeness and producing severance can be assigned an indistinguishable form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نجعل can activate naming, while the two definite plurals present rival classifications.
baseline_models.mechanism: The likeness is not only an outcome but a possible act of saying or classing one kind as another. The question challenges the validity and authority of that classification.

activation_trace.role: Saying or naming makes نجعل a possible classificatory act.
Soundness gives one classification substantive content rather than a bare title.
Offense gives the counter-classification substantive content.

changed_reading.before: The question promises unequal treatment after identities are already settled.
changed_reading.after: The question also audits the act by which unlike moral descriptions would be named, entered, or treated as one class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pen, written line, assay, and distinguishing mark turn the baseline naming model into diagnostic inscription: the contrast in 68:35 is a finding made visible and recordable, not arbitrary favoritism.

activation_trace.role: Naming anchors the changed reading in the classificatory possibility of نجعل.
The prepared writing implement supplies the means by which a distinction can become a record.
The ordered written line supplies inscription rather than an ungrounded label.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a process through which concealed quality becomes evident.
A mark that distinguishes and guides supplies the legible criterion separating the classes.

structural_cues: The surah moves from writing in 68:1 through reciprocal seeing in 68:5 and assay in 68:6 to discriminating knowledge in 68:7.
The branchless و س م cue at 68:16 contributes only the structural prospect of a visible mark; no branch identifier is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, assay, and distinguishing marks; I infer that they converge on an evidentiary classification in 68:35, while they may instead remain separate rhetorical motifs.

changed_reading.before: God simply prefers one already named group over another.
changed_reading.after: The unequal classification is presented as the legible result of disclosure and testing, as though conduct has written the distinction that judgment reads.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners withhold good, plan to cut the crop, contract against entry, and end deprived. This activates المجرمين as cutters whose exclusionary cut returns upon them, while المسلمين carries the contrary motion of handing over and release.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and letting go anchor the circulating, non-withholding pole of the contrast.
Cutting and harvesting anchor المجرمين in the garden's repeated material action.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the social motive later enacted against the poor person.
Palm harvesting supplies the intended literal cut that closely activates the focus root's harvest branch.
A severed piece supplies the garden's transformed state as the consequence mirrors the plan.
Prevention and contraction supply the owners' exclusionary posture at the moment of action.
Deprivation and loss supply the returned result: those who meant to exclude now name themselves excluded.

structural_cues: Across 68:17-27, intended harvest, exclusion of the poor, the garden's becoming like a cut thing, and the owners' deprivation form a reversal.
The focus question follows their confession and the announcement of opposed gardens in 68:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, harvest-cutting, contraction, and resulting deprivation; I infer a reciprocal arrow in which the social cut rebounds on the cutters, though the sequence can also be read as punishment without lexical reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Criminals are generic sinners contrasted with believers.
changed_reading.after: The criminals are legible as agents of severance: they cut produce and beneficiaries apart, acquire that act, and are themselves cut off from what they tried to monopolize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners turn toward their Lord and hope for substitution, while Jonah is selected and made among the sound-doing. These transitions prevent المسلمين and المجرمين from hardening into biological castes: جعل places persons into accountable states that can be revised through response and mercy.

activation_trace.role: Turning a person into a state anchors the focus categories as placements rather than essences.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the owners' live horizon of changed condition.
Directed desire supplies their relational turn toward the Lord after confession.
Selection and drawing near supply the initiating mercy in Jonah's changed placement.
The repeated state-making verb directly demonstrates that جعل can relocate a person into a new collective standing.
Sound action opposed to corruption supplies the destination of Jonah's placement.

structural_cues: The garden owners move from wrongdoing and excess in 68:29-31 to desire toward their Lord in 68:32.
The exact sequence فجعله من الصالحين in 68:50 provides a later grammatical demonstration of divine placement among a class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confession, redirected desire, substitution, selection, and a later making-among; I infer category permeability under response and mercy, while an alternative keeps only Jonah's case reversible.

changed_reading.before: The verse fixes two immutable kinds of human being.
changed_reading.after: The verse refuses equal valuation of two present standings without denying movement between them; its distinction is morally real but not caste-like.

context_deltas.mechanism: The questions after 68:35 demand a judgment, book, chosen entitlement, oath, and guarantor. They turn نجعل into an adjudicative classification whose contrary claim must produce a warrant.

activation_trace.role: Naming anchors the focus question as a disputed classification.
Judgment between parties names the act immediately demanded after the focus comparison.
A written establishment that imposes a ruling supplies the missing documentary warrant.
Entering a name in a register or group concretizes the classificatory force of making one group like another.
Choosing what one prefers exposes the self-serving entitlement that the alleged book would guarantee.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the personal surety demanded for the rival judgment.

structural_cues: The uninterrupted interrogation in 68:36-41 repeatedly asks who authorizes, records, guarantees, or shares responsibility for the proposed equivalence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, binding writing, registry, choice, and guarantee; I infer a burden-of-proof procedure aimed at the equality claim, though each question can be read more generally as ridicule of false entitlement.

changed_reading.before: The verse is only a declaration that rewards will differ.
changed_reading.after: It opens a forensic hearing: anyone claiming equivalence must identify the judgment, registry, covenant, or guarantor that could authorize it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those later unable to prostrate had formerly been called while سالمون. Soundness was an available capacity; surrender was the response that could have enacted it. المسلمين therefore becomes more than a communal title, and equality with المجرمين would erase the difference between exercised and refused capacity.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and letting go anchor المسلمين as enacted surrender.
Ability and capacity supply the later incapacity that exposes an earlier unused possibility.
The call and verbal inclination supply the invitation to convert capacity into response.
Lowering and submission supply the concrete act that was refused while still possible.
Being sound and free of impairment supplies the earlier condition in which response remained available.

structural_cues: The temporal reversal in 68:42-43 places present inability after a prior summons issued while they were sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, prostration, capacity, and prior soundness; I infer that المسلمين names sound capacity realized as surrender, while سالمون may alternatively denote only bodily ability.

changed_reading.before: Muslims are simply the members of one named group.
changed_reading.after: They are heard as those who convert an available condition of soundness into responsive self-lowering before that capacity closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking and extended time activate المجرمين as an acquired and completed trajectory. The questioned likeness concerns endpoints formed through different histories, not an instantaneous sorting of static types.

activation_trace.role: Turning into a state anchors the eventual standing as something formed.
Earning or causing to incur anchors the standing in accumulated action.
Completed and cut-off time supplies an exploratory endpoint image within the focus root.
Taking degree by degree supplies the hidden incremental process by which the endpoint forms.
Extension and respite in time supply the duration within which acquired conduct matures.

structural_cues: The declaration of gradual drawing in 68:44 is immediately followed by temporal respite in 68:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies degrees, delay, earning, and completed time; I infer a trajectory from repeated acts to settled standing, while the alternative is simply delayed punishment after classification.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares two timeless labels.
changed_reading.after: It compares standings produced by histories: one cannot erase the accrued direction of conduct when judging the formed endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fee, binding liability, and heavy burden in 68:46 sharpen جرم's earning-and-incurring branch. المجرمين becomes an accountability term for those carrying what their acts have entered against them.

activation_trace.role: Earning and causing to incur anchor criminal standing in acquired liability.
Compensation for work supplies one side of the verse's explicit accounting scene.
A financial liability that adheres supplies the obligation imagined as resting on them.
Loading with a burden supplies the felt weight of incurred obligation.

structural_cues: The question in 68:46 couples a demanded fee with the possibility that its hearers are burdened by liability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wage, attached liability, burden, and the focus root's earning branch; I infer an accountability ledger, while the immediate question may only deny that prophetic payment explains rejection.

changed_reading.before: A criminal is defined chiefly by a stigmatized essence.
changed_reading.after: A criminal is one who has acquired and now carries an answerable liability; unequal standing tracks what has been incurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene shows opponents trying through speech to unseat the messenger by assigning him madness, while the discourse is reaffirmed as a reminder and document of right. This makes the naming branch of نجعل a contest over whether a spoken designation can truly constitute standing.

activation_trace.role: Saying or naming anchors the focus comparison in the power and limits of designation.
Saying what is not so or attributing it to another supplies the opponents' false constitutive claim.
Covering the mind with madness supplies the damaging category they try to impose.
Sliding a thing from its station supplies the intended social effect of the hostile label.
A document of right supplies a stable counter-record to hostile speech.

structural_cues: In 68:51-52, attempted visual displacement and the spoken label مجنون are answered by the assertion that the discourse is nothing but a reminder for all worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, madness, displacement, and a right-document; I infer that 68:35 distinguishes warranted divine classification from hostile social labeling, while the closing attack may be independent of the focus comparison.

changed_reading.before: Making the two groups alike concerns only their final treatment.
changed_reading.after: It also concerns who can make a designation hold: hostile speech may try to manufacture identity, but a label without truth cannot establish the standing it asserts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because نجعل is a finite verb in a comparative construction, not the noun جعالة; it remains anchored by the focus root's stipulated-reward branch and the surah's repeated wage/liability frame. Render it only as an economic analogy that colors allocation, never as a replacement translation of نجعل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نجعل carries a branch for assigning recompense, while the compared collectives occupy the object and likeness slots.

activation_trace.role: A stipulated reward for work supplies the form-distant recompense coloring within the focus verb's root.
Recompense and wage supply the opening promise of payment for work.
The repeated wage term makes compensation an explicit question after the focus verse.
Adhering financial liability supplies the negative side of the same accounting analogy.

changed_reading.before: نجعل only means placing one class in the same state as another.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the root field, the question also sounds like an allocation problem: could recompense be assigned as though surrendered service and incurred liability were equivalent accounts?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because pen-trimming, written lines, and harvest-cutting are not identical senses. It remains valid as an anchored material network around جرم's cutting branch and the explicit garden cuts. Downstream prose should call it a recurrent image of differentiation, not claim that every cited word literally means criminality.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المجرمين supplies the cutting/harvesting branch inside a construction that asks whether a distinction will be maintained.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and harvesting anchor the material network in the focus noun.

A detached piece supplies a late echo of separation, even though the surface imperative means leaving.

changed_reading.before: The comparison draws an abstract moral boundary.
changed_reading.after: A recurrent cutting image lets the boundary feel made: the pen is pared, a line is cut, the harvest is severed, and المجرمين names those implicated in destructive cutting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the snakebitten sense is a lexical counter-name and should not translate المسلمين or سالمون. It remains anchored in the shared سلم inventory and becomes live beside the prior-soundness scene. Render only as a paradoxical resonance: called sound can name vulnerable hope or yielding under injury, not assured invulnerability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المسلمين activates the سلم branch in which the snakebitten is called sound either hopefully or because the injury has been yielded to.

activation_trace.role: The wounded person counter-named sound supplies paradoxical, non-triumphal soundness within the focus root.
The same counter-naming branch makes سالمون capable of carrying a fragile or hopeful resonance beside ordinary ability.
The summons supplies the moment at which vulnerable soundness is asked to become response.

changed_reading.before: The Muslim side represents an untouched, self-secure wholeness.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, its soundness can include vulnerable or hopeful yielding: integrity is not immunity from injury but a way of answering while exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because سلم as ladder is nominally distant from المسلمين, and درج supplies both ordinary steps and ominous gradual taking. It remains anchored by exact packet branches and the focus's state-making comparison. Render as a spatial analogy for opposed trajectories, not as lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المسلمين carries a ladder-or-means branch, while نجعل can turn persons into a state.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means supplies an ascending spatial trajectory within the focus predicate's root field.
State-making anchors the question in where differing trajectories finally place their subjects.
Taking degree by degree supplies a counter-trajectory whose smooth progress conceals its direction.
Extended time supplies the span across which the graded movement unfolds.

changed_reading.before: The two collectives stand side by side as static classes.
changed_reading.after: They can also appear at the ends of unlike graded movements: one takes a means of responsive ascent, while the other is drawn by degrees along an apparently easy descent.

strongest_changes: The garden narrative turns المجرمين from a generic moral label into cutters whose attempted severance of crop from beneficiary returns as their own deprivation.
The post-focus legal questions make the comparison a warranted classification requiring judgment, record, and guarantor.
The سالمون-to-inability sequence makes المسلمين an enacted use of available soundness, while Jonah's later making-among صالحين keeps standing real but revisable.
Gradual drawing, respite, wage, liability, and burden recast criminal standing as an accrued and answerable endpoint rather than an essence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots become unusually concrete across the surah: soundness becomes surrender under available capacity, جرم becomes harvest-cutting and incurred liability, and جعل becomes inscription, adjudication, and reversible placement. The readings coexist without reducing the verse to one axis.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal-cutting model is strongly activated by the garden sequence, but the causal rebound remains reader-supplied rather than grammatically stated in 68:35.
It remains open how much المسلمين should carry soundness versus handing-over in this occurrence.
The reward, wounded-soundness, cut-line, and ladder readings are branch-valid resonances but too form-distant to use as direct translations.
The reversible-status reading should not dissolve the verse's present moral distinction into eventual sameness.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A rejected making-equivalent.** `ج ع ل B002` supplies turning something into a state; `س ل م B001` gives soundness/safety and `ج ر م B004` guilt/offense. The interrogative comparison asks whether governance will assign unlike moral states an identical outcome. I infer meaningful judgment requires distinctions to have consequences; the ayah refuses equivalence as a corruption of classification.
2. **Those who hand over versus those who cut off.** `س ل م B012` supplies handing over and letting go, while `ج ر م B001` supplies cutting off and harvesting. The garden narrative makes the harvest branch unusually active. I infer one group relinquishes absolute self-claim whereas the other acquires by severing; the contrast becomes a difference in how possession and agency are handled, not only in labels.
3. **Soundness against incurred consequence.** `ج ر م B003` supplies earning or causing someone to incur a burden. Set beside 68:3's recompense and 68:46's denied fee, I infer actions generate unlike returns. The ayah asks whether sound yielding and culpable acquisition can rationally produce the same account.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:42-43 makes the distinction embodied: prior sound capacity and present compelled abasement are not interchangeable states. 68:50 reuses *jaʿala* positively when the Lord makes the selected one among the sound, confirming that “making” is a morally ordered placement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Judgment distinguishes modes of relation, not arbitrary labels.** Fixed `نَجْعَل` activates `ج ع ل B002` (turning something into a state), fixed `ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ` activates `س ل م B012` (handing over and letting go), and fixed `ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ` activates `ج ر م B003` (earning or causing one to incur) and `ج ر م B004` (offense). The owners' movement from mutual blame through confessed excess to desire directed toward their Lord in 68:30-32 supplies the contrast; I infer that surrender and incurred offense are causal states produced by opposed ways of handling agency. The question rejects flattening those states into one outcome.
2. **Soundness cannot be equated with severed guilt.** Fixed `ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ` also activates `س ل م B001` (soundness), while `ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ` activates `ج ر م B001` (cutting off and harvesting). The completed garden consequence in 68:30-33 supplies the residue of a severing act; I infer that wrongdoing cuts agents from a sound relation even when both groups appear under one generic human category. The rhetorical comparison is therefore about structural integrity as well as moral status.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:36-40 turned the comparison into an audit of warrants, choices, oaths, and guarantors. That later interrogation corrected any arbitrary-classification reading: fixed `نَجْعَل` concerns states whose differentiation must be justly grounded.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Protected Growth Turns Cover into Provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A productive enclosure protects living growth long enough for seed, plant, fruit, animal, and human occupant to reach a beneficial state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Paradise is lexically materialized as shield, tree-cover, seed-cover, fruit husk, cultivated field, and usable tree product; protection is productive rather than merely defensive.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Shielded Garden Gives Its Occupant Ease
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A protective barrier and dense tree-cover preserve an interior where the occupant can remain sound, settled, and well-provisioned.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: barrier against harm (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); self placed in protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m04`); protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m03`); soundness from defect (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`); favor and good condition (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m02`); softness and ease (`quranic:root_001525:B002/m02`); congenial place of residence (`quranic:root_001525:B011/m01`); lordship over the protected domain (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m02`); gracious provision (`quranic:root_000532:B016/m04`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:34 `مُتَّقِينَ` [و ق ي], `رَبِّ` [ر ب ب], `جَنَّٰتِ` [ج ن ن], and `نَّعِيمِ` [ن ع م]; 68:35 `مُسْلِمِينَ` [س ل م].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Protection is an enabling environment. Barrier and tree-cover preserve soundness, while ease and congenial residence name the state made possible inside; the “gardens of delight” therefore join enclosure to sustained flourishing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Seed is covered in soil, new vegetation thickens, a fruit remains sheathed until ripe, and the yield emerges from its protected stage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: covering seed with soil (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); fruit or palm sheath (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`); dense plant growth (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m03`); ripe pasture or fruit ready for use (`quranic:root_000956:B007/m01`); young palms (`quranic:root_000248:B006/m01`); strong male plant (`quranic:root_000516:B002/m01`); crop yield and fruit (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); persistent green growth (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m03`).

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal ön ödemeli vadeli alışverişle sınırlıdır; genel borç, faiz, barış ve basamaklı araç anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: İşlem adı ile belirli mala ilişkin ön ödeme kalıbı ayrı tutulur; kalıp anlamı kökün diğer yalın dallarına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir satışta para ya da bedelin önceden verildiği, satın alınan malın ise belirlenen daha sonraki zamanda sağlandığı vadeli işlemdir.

facets.statement: Bir malın bedelini önceden verme esasına dayanan vadeli satış işlemidir.
Belirli bir yiyecek ya da başka mal için ödeme önceden yapılarak işlem kurulabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar işlem adını, bir mal için para veya bedelin önceden verilmesi ve karşılığın vadeli olması temelinde açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ön ödeme ile daha sonra sağlanacak mal arasındaki işlem düzenini eksiksiz belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: Bedelin önceden verilmesi ve malın vadeli olması şartlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir mal için paranın teslimden önce verildiği eylem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ödemenin maldan önce yapılması koşulunu korur.
error_profile.loses: İşlemin bütün vadeli satış yapısını ve işlem adı boyutunu kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Malın daha sonra sağlandığı belirli bir ön ödemeli satış düzenini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Önceden verilen parayı hem borç hem de vadeli satış bedeli olarak daha geniş kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ön ödemeli satış ile önden verilen para
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir işlem kapsamında paranın karşılıktan önce verilmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir satış türünün yapısını anlatır; komşu dal ise önden verilen parayı, borç verme durumunu da içine alacak biçimde genişçe adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bedelin peşin, malın ise vadeli olduğu belirli satış türüne özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel borçlanmayı, ödünç parayı ve süreli alacak ilişkilerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ödemenin ve karşılığın farklı zamanlarda gerçekleşebildiği mali işlemler alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal peşin bedel karşılığında ileride mal sağlanmasına dayanır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise geri ödenecek borç veya alacak ilişkisidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün mali işlem adayları incelendi; işlemle en çok karışabilecek önden verilen para ve genel borç dalları yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السلم أو السلف في المعاملة: المال أو الثمن الذي يقدم أو يسلف.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو السلم بمعنى الصلح، ولا السلم الذي يرتقى عليه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السلم الذي يسمى السلف كأنه مال أسلم (maqayis)؛ السلم ما أسلفت به (ayn)؛ السلم بالتحريك السلف وأسلم الرجل في الطعام أي أسلف فيه (sihah)؛ السلم السلف يقال أسلم في كذا وأسلف فيه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem üzerine basılarak çıkılan basamaklı aracı hem de bir hedefe ulaştıran sebep veya aracı açıkça verir. İkinci kullanım, fiziksel yükselme aracından amaçsal araca uzanan bir genişlemedir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal basamaklı çıkma aracı ve ulaştırıcı araçla sınırlıdır; yükselme eyleminin kendisi ya da her yol bu çekirdeğe girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal fiziksel merdiven ile bir amaca ulaştıran araç anlamlarını kapsar; komşu eylem ve yol anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yukarı çıkmak için basamaklarına basılan araçtır; buradan genişleyerek bir amaca ulaştıran sebep veya aracı da anlatır.

facets.statement: Üzerindeki basamaklara basılarak yukarı çıkmayı sağlayan araçtır.
Bir hedefe ulaşmayı mümkün kılan sebep, yol veya araç anlamına genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar basamaklı çıkma aracında birleşir ve aynı sözcüğün bir şeye ulaştıran sebep ya da araç için de kullanıldığını bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel çıkma aracını ve ondan gelişen amaçsal araç kullanımını birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Basamaklı çıkma aracı ile hedefe ulaştıran araç anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Basamaklarına basılarak yukarı çıkılan fiziksel araç bağlamında tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Basamaklı fiziksel çıkma aracını tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir amaca ulaştıran soyut sebep veya araç genişlemesini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hedefe varmayı sağlayan sebep veya araç için kullanılan soyut bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir hedefe ulaştıran araç ve sebep anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Fiziksel basamaklı merdiven anlamını açıkça taşımaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: merdiven veya bir hedefe ulaştıran araç

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Üzerine basılan aracı ve hedefe ulaştıran aracı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Merdiven, gök, dağ ya da derecede adım adım yükselme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da basamaklar üzerinden yukarıya doğru ilerleme sahnesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çıkmayı sağlayan nesne veya araçtır; komşu dal ise o araçla ya da başka biçimde gerçekleşen yükselme hareketidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Basamaklı çıkma aracını ve hedefe ulaştıran aracı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Üzerinde ilerlenen genel yolu ve bir şeye erişmenin türlü yöntemlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir yere ya da amaca erişmeyi mümkün kılan vasıtaları anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın somut çekirdeği basamaklı çıkma aracıdır ve soyut kullanım ona bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği üzerinde gidilen yol ve genel erişim yöntemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; nesne ile yükselme eylemi ve araç ile genel yol ayrımlarını gösteren iki komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السلم والسلاليم التي يرتقى عليها، والسبب أو الوسيلة المؤدية إلى الشيء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الصلح ولا السلف، ولا الدلو ذات العروة الواحدة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السلم أي السبب والمرقاة والجميع السلاليم (ayn)؛ السلم واحد السلاليم التي يرتقى عليها (sihah)؛ السلم الذي يرتقى عليه والسبب إلى الشيء (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gevşek ve kolay dağılan maddeden farklı olarak sertliğiyle nitelenen taşlar topluluğu ve bu topluluğun tek bir taşıdır.

facets.statement: Sert ve dayanıklı taşlar topluluğunu belirtir.
Tekil biçimi, sert taşlar topluluğundan bir taşı belirtir.
Adlandırma, taşların sertlikleri nedeniyle kolay yok olmamalarına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.text: sert taşlar ve tekil sert taş
concept_gloss.applicability: Sert taşlar topluluğu ile bu topluluktan tek bir taşı belirten kullanımları birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sert taşlar topluluğu ve tekil sert taş kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birden çok sert ve dayanıklı taşın topluca adlandırıldığı bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sert taşlardan oluşan topluluk anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek bir taşı belirten tekil kullanım açıkça gösterilmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kutsal taşa elle dokunma ya da onu öpme

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dal yalnız sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma malzemesini tuttuğu için yayımlanacak güvenilir komşu ayrımı seçilmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السلام والسلمة للحجارة الصلبة أو جماعة الحجارة، وما فسر من ذلك بسلامتها من الرخاوة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو السلام بمعنى التحية، ولا السلامة المعنوية، ولا الشجر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحجارة سميت سلاما لأنها أبعد شيء من الفناء لشدتها (maqayis)؛ السلام الحجارة (ayn)؛ السلمة واحدة السلام وهي الحجارة (sihah)؛ السلام بكسر السين الحجارة الصلبة والواحدة سلمة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dikenli bir ağaç türünü ve bu ağacın yaprak ya da kabuğunun deri tabaklamada kullanılmasını ortak çekirdek olarak destekler. Ağaç adı ile onun kullanıldığı tabaklama eylemi ayrı yüzlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli ağaç ve onunla deri tabaklama kullanımıyla sınırlıdır; genel esenlik ve taş adları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ağaç adları yalın kapsamı, deri tabaklama söz öbeği ise yapım kullanımını oluşturur; kalıp yalın anlama dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaprağı veya kabuğu deri tabaklamada kullanılan dikenli bir ağaçtır; ağacın malzemesiyle deriyi işleme eylemi de bu dala bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Yaprak ve kabuğundan yararlanılan dikenli bir ağaç türüdür.
Ağacın yaprağı ya da kabuğu deri tabaklamak için kullanılır.
Ağaç malzemesiyle deriyi tabaklama eylemi için özel bir fiil kullanımı oluşur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dikenli ağaç adında ve yaprak ya da kabuğunun deri tabaklamada kullanılmasında birleşir; ayrıca bu malzemeyle deriyi işleme eylemini bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ağacın ayırt edici niteliğini ve temel kullanımını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Dikenli ağaç kimliğini ve tabaklamada kullanılan yaprak ile kabuğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağacın yaprak veya kabuğuyla derinin işlendiği eylem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaç malzemesini kullanarak deri tabaklama eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ağacın bağımsız tür adı olarak kullanımını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ağacın yaprak ya da kabuğuyla deriyi tabaklamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dikenli ağaç ile onun yaprak veya kabuğundan yararlanan tabaklama kullanımını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka bir ağaç türünü, onunla işlenmiş su kabını ve onu yiyen develerdeki rahatsızlığı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da deri tabaklamada malzemesi kullanılan bir ağaç ve o malzemeyle işleme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İşlevleri benzer olsa da dallar farklı ağaç türlerini adlandırır; komşu dal ayrıca işlenmiş kap ve hayvan rahatsızlığı gibi kendine özgü kullanımlara sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün bitki ve tabaklama adayları değerlendirildi; işlevce en yakın fakat türce ayrı olan ağaç dalı seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السلم والسلام والسلامة والسلامان أسماء للشجر، وورقه أو قشره الذي يدبغ به الجلد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو السلامة من الآفات إلا من جهة تسمية ذكرها بعض المصادر، ولا هو الحجارة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السلامة شجر والسلم شجر والسلامان شجر (maqayis)؛ السلم ضرب من الشجر وورقه القرظ يدبغ به (ayn)؛ السلم شجر من العضاه والواحدة سلمة وسلمت الجلد إذا دبغته بالسلم (sihah)؛ السلام شجر والسلمة شجرة ذات شوك يدبغ بورقها وقشرها (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ana kullanımın yılan tarafından ısırılmış kişiyi adlandırdığını destekler ve bu adı iyileşme dileğine ya da kişinin başına gelene boyun eğmesine bağlayan iki açıklama verir. Bununla birlikte ısırma olayının kendisini adlandıran kullanım yalnız bir aktarımda geçer ve başka bir kaynakça açıkça sorgulanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği ısırılmış kişidir; ısırma olayını adlandırma yalnızca tartışmalı bir kaynak değişkesi olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal ısırılmış kişi adını taşır; tartışmalı ısırma olayı kullanımı çekirdekle eşitlenmeden kaynak değişkesi olarak belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Yılan tarafından ısırılmış kişiye, iyileşmesi umularak ya da uğradığı duruma çaresiz kaldığı düşünülerek verilen addır. Isırma olayının kendisi için kullanıldığı aktarımı tartışmalıdır.

facets.statement: Yılan tarafından ısırılmış kişiyi belirtir.
Ad, kimi açıklamalarda iyileşme dileğine, kimilerinde kişinin başına gelene boyun eğmesine bağlanır.
Yılan ısırması olayını adlandırdığı aktarımı başka bir kaynak tarafından kuşkuyla karşılanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek yılan tarafından ısırılmış kişidir; adın iyileşme dileğinden mi yoksa çaresiz kalmadan mı doğduğu konusunda iki açıklama vardır. Isırma olayının kendisini bildirdiği aktarımı ise kaynaklar arasında tartışmalıdır.

concept_gloss.text: iyileşme dileğiyle adlandırılan yılan ısırığı mağduru
concept_gloss.applicability: Isırılmış kişi çekirdeğini ve adlandırmanın iyimser açıklamasını açıkça gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Yılan tarafından ısırılmış kişi ve iyileşme dileği açıklamasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Çaresiz kalma açıklamasını ve tartışmalı ısırma olayı kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adlandırmanın köken açıklamasını öne çıkarmadan kişiyi belirten bağlamlarda en açık karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yılan tarafından ısırılmış kişi çekirdeğini tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: İyimser adlandırma ve çaresiz kalma açıklamalarını belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iyileşme dileğiyle adlandırılan yılan ısırığı mağduru

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Isırılmış kişiyi ve ona verilen iyimser ya da açıklayıcı adı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yılanın dişleriyle gerçekleştirdiği ısırma ve koparma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yılanın bir kişiyi dişleriyle yaraladığı aynı olayda yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olaydan etkilenen kişiyi adlandırır; komşu dal ise yılanın gerçekleştirdiği ısırma eylemini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yılan tarafından ısırılmış kişiyi, acısının sürüp sürmediğine bakmadan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Isırılmış kişinin ağrısının dinip kendine geldiği sonraki durumu belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ısırılmış kişi ile ağrısı dinen kişi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yılan ısırığına uğrayan kişinin farklı durumlarını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ısırığa uğramış olmayı temel alır; komşu dal ise bundan sonraki iyileşme aşamasında ağrının dinmesini gerekli kılar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün ısırık ve zarar adayları incelendi; kişi ile eylem ve ısırılma ile sonraki iyileşme aşaması ayrımları seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السليم والمسلوم للملدوغ، مع تعليلين: التفاؤل بالسلامة أو أنه أسلم لما به.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هذا فرع السلامة الحقيقي إلا على جهة التفاؤل أو القلب، ولا يعتمد جعل السلم نفسه مصدرا للدغ دون تنبيه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السليم وهو اللديغ قيل أسلم لما به وقيل تفاءلوا بالسلامة (maqayis)؛ السلم لدغ الحية والملدوغ مسلوم وسليم (ayn)؛ السلام والسليم اللديغ تفاءلوا له بالسلامة ويقال أسلم لما به (sihah)؛ الملدوغ مسلوم وسليم ثم قلت وما قاله غيره في السلم اللدغ (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi parmaklarda, ayakta ve devenin tırnak bölgesinde bulunan küçük kemikleri ortak anatomik çekirdek olarak verir. Geçici çerçevenin kemik ve eklem ifadesi, kaynakta açıkça kemik olarak sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal küçük kemikleri adlandırır; genel olarak bütün eklemleri, parmak uçlarını ya da kalça ve diz bölgelerini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal parmak, ayak ve deve tırnak bölgesindeki küçük kemiklerle sınırlıdır; komşu anatomik parçalar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın parmak veya ayak kemiklerinden biri ya da devenin tırnak bölgesinde bulunan küçük bir kemiktir.

facets.statement: Parmaklarda ve ayakta bulunan küçük kemiklerden her biridir.
Hayvan anatomisinde özellikle devenin tırnak bölgesindeki bir kemiği belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar küçük parmak ve ayak kemikleri üzerinde birleşir; daha özel açıklamalar sözcüğün devenin tırnak bölgesindeki bir kemik için de kullanıldığını belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: parmak, ayak veya deve tırnağındaki küçük kemik
concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan ve deve anatomisindeki bütün tanıklanmış küçük kemik kapsamını birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük kemik niteliğini ve parmak, ayak ile deve tırnağı kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan parmaklarındaki küçük kemiklerden biri söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Parmakta bulunan küçük kemik anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ayak kemikleri ile devenin tırnak bölgesindeki özel kemiği kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: parmak, ayak veya deve tırnağındaki küçük kemik

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Parmak, ayak ve deve tırnak bölgesindeki belirli küçük kemiklerle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Vücuttaki eklemleri veya tek tek ayrılan kemikleri genel olarak kapsar.
